title: Color-Matched Capping Coil — Installation Jobs
content:
**Color-matched coil for trim capping — Installation Jobs**

Color-matched coil is added for every priced opening when exterior trim capping is priced on an **Installation Jobs** record whose **Window Replacement Contracts** contract carries an exterior color change order. The adder depends on the series of that window contract:

| Window contract the job installs | Color-matched coil adder |
|---|---|
| carries an exterior color change order, series Ridgeline 5500 Series Fiberglass or Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad | $22.00 per priced opening |
| carries an exterior color change order, any other series | $14.00 per priced opening |
| carries no exterior color change order | none |

A change order counts here only when it is an exterior color change; change orders of other kinds do not bring in color-matched coil. A door job installs no window contract and carries no color-matched coil adder.

## Combinations (hypothetical contracts)

| Exterior color change order | Series | Adder per priced opening |
|---|---|---|
| yes | Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad | $22.00 |
| yes | Ridgeline 5500 Series Fiberglass | $22.00 |
| yes | Ridgeline 3300 Series Premium Vinyl | $14.00 |
| no | Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad | none |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A window contract in the Ridgeline 4400 Series Composite carries an exterior color change order and the job has 9 priced openings. The color-matched coil comes to 9 multiplied by 14.00, that is 126.00.
